title: Fees & tax rates
description: Tax rates and the service fees charged on top of ticket prices. Events can adjust or waive global fees in their “Fees” tab.
readOnly: You can view these settings. Changing them requires the Finance role.

howItWorks.title: How fees are charged
howItWorks.perTicket: Per ticket – for every ticket of an event: a fixed amount or a percentage of the ticket price (after reductions).
howItWorks.perEvent: Once per event – once for each event in the order: a fixed amount or a percentage of that event's tickets.
howItWorks.perOrder: Once per order – once per order, however many events it contains. Only possible as a global fee, always with its own tax rate.
howItWorks.filters: Fees can be limited to payment methods (e.g. a PayPal surcharge) and sales channels. Amounts are gross – the tax is included.
howItWorks.events: Every event inherits the global fees. In the event's “Fees” tab a global fee can be adjusted (own values) or waived, and event-only fees can be added.
howItWorks.snapshots: Orders store their fees and tax amounts – changes only apply to new orders.

taxRates.title: Tax rates
taxRates.description: VAT rates for tickets and fees. Each event uses one tax rate; fees use the event's rate unless they have their own.
taxRates.name: Name
taxRates.invoiceNoteHint: Printed on invoices, e.g. the legal notice for tax-exempt or small-business sales.
taxRates.usageValue: {events, plural, =0 {no events} one {# event} other {# events}} · {fees, plural, =0 {no fees} one {# fee} other {# fees}}
taxRates.isActive: Active – offered for new events and fees
taxRates.defaultMustBeActive: The default tax rate must be active.
taxRates.rateChangeHint: A changed rate applies to new orders only; existing orders and invoices keep their tax amounts.
taxRates.inUseHint: In use by events or fees – deactivate it instead.

global.title: Global fees
global.description: Charged for every event (in this order) unless an event adjusts or waives them.
global.empty: No fees – tickets are sold at their ticket price.
global.deleteDescription: “{name}” will be deleted. Existing orders keep their fee lines.
global.deleteOverrides: {count, plural, one {The adjustment of # event is deleted as well.} other {The adjustments of # events are deleted as well.}}

event.globalDescription: Inherited from the global fees. Adjust a fee to give this event its own values, or waive it.
event.orderFeesDescription: Global fees charged once per order. They cannot be adjusted per event.
event.ownDescription: Additional fees charged only for tickets of this event.
event.adjustDescription: These values replace the global fee for this event only.
event.waiveDescription: The fee is no longer charged for this event. You can reset it to the global fee at any time.
event.resetDescription: The event's own values are removed and the global fee applies again.
event.deleteDescription: “{name}” will be deleted. Existing orders keep their fee lines.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Shown to customers in the checkout and on invoices.
form.taxRateRequired: Fees charged once per order need their own tax rate.
form.allHint: Tick all to apply the fee everywhere (also to options added later).
form.scopeLocked: Events adjust this fee, so it cannot be charged once per order. Reset their adjustments first.
